threads.title: Personal Guide to Writing Lorebooks for SpicyChat.AI

messages.author: Duke
messages.content:
*Based on my experience using lorebooks on SpicyChat, here’s what I’ve found works best for creating consistent, usable, and effective lore for world-building and storytelling.*

**How Lorebooks Work**

Lorebooks are structured guides that help the AI remember context, maintain consistency, and respond according to your world or story. They are not meant to replace character creation.

*Keyword Triggers:* Specific words or phrases that, when mentioned in chat, prompt the AI to reference relevant lore entries.

*Memory Reinforcement:* Keeps characters, settings, and story elements consistent across interactions.

World-Building: Ideal for RPGs, fanfiction, or interactive storytelling where internal logic and continuity matter.

From my personal experience, thinking of a lorebook as a tool to guide the AI, rather than a book or character itself, gives the best results.
